files.description: Hand-written Playwright coverage for service choices, fake Immich connection/discovery, OneDrive account sharing/scope reconsent, target consent reviews, read-only provider previews, Folder import/export, filters, and run history.

testContext: The suite uses the standard one-instance seed and runs serially because it creates sync automations and imports fixture photos. Folder target output is placed under Playwright testInfo.outputPath so the isolated app can write to it and the runner can discard it with test artifacts. Import source files are the checked-in yaffo_ui_tests/test_data/photos fixtures. Sync pages live at /utilities/automations/<slug>; setup panels are #sync-step-options and #sync-step-where; the header toggle is .automation-actions [role="switch"], Test is #sync-test, Run now is #sync-run-now, Items are under #sync-items, and run rows poll under #automation-runs. New automation selection lives in #newAutomationModal. The UI uses hidden native selects wrapped by .searchable-select-wrapper; select options through .searchable-select-display and .searchable-select-option.
explanation: Hand-written from specs/sync_automations.yaml after inspecting sync detail/account, filter, item and run-history templates plus sync routes. The isolated runner starts local OneDrive, Immich and Flickr services for provider scenarios and passes origin overrides to Flask and taskq. Coverage verifies Immich connection validation and collection discovery; OneDrive OAuth account sharing, source preview reads without downloads, target write-scope reconsent, and destination/removal consent review before enabling and after selection changes. Album-change event coalescing and remaining provider reconciliation/provenance scenarios remain uncovered.
